packageRules.description: Packages pinned below Colab's version due to Forge API compatibility — require manual review before merging
gradio must stay on 4.x — Forge uses the 4.x UI API
Pillow must stay below 11.0 — gradio 4.x requires pillow<11.0
transformers must stay on 4.x — Forge relies on the 4.x API
protobuf must stay on 3.x — Forge hardcodes the 3.x API; protobuf 4+ is a breaking rewrite
accelerate must stay on 0.x — v1 introduced breaking API changes for Forge; floor at 0.34.2 (last 0.x; has clear_device_cache natively; supports numpy 2.x)
peft pinned for Forge/accelerate compatibility — must stay on 0.x; Renovate may bump within 0.x after CI validation
open-clip-torch must stay on 2.x — v3 may introduce breaking API changes incompatible with Forge
huggingface-hub must stay on 0.x — 1.x removed HfFolder (gradio 4.40.0 imports it); floor at 0.25.0 for peft 0.21.2 which needs LocalEntryNotFoundError

starlette floor at 1.3.1 — first release fixing GHSA-82w8-qh3p-5jfq (url-encoded form parser ignores max_fields/max_part_size); also fixes CVE-2024-47874 (multipart) and CVE-2025-62727 (Range header); old-style TemplateResponse(name, context) restored via build_blob.sh patch
fastapi floor at 0.133.0 — first release that drops the starlette<1.0.0 upper bound, making it compatible with starlette 1.3.1
httpx must satisfy gradio 4.40.0 (>=0.24.1); manual review — gradio's HTTP client is API-sensitive

pydantic must stay on 2.x — gradio 4.40.0 requires >=2.0; v3 would be a major API rewrite; manual review because pydantic minor releases have had breaking changes; grouped with pydantic-core so they are always bumped together in one PR
pydantic-core must match pydantic exactly — grouped with pydantic so Renovate always bumps both in the same PR; an independent pydantic-core bump would produce a conflicting pin
Forge-specific packages and stable pinned packages — safe to automerge patch/minor updates
pip dependency updates change the blob — use fix(deps) to trigger a patch release
GitHub Actions updates only affect CI, not the blob — use chore(ci)
npm updates are toolchain-only, not the blob — use chore(deps)
pytorch_lightning is pinned hard by Forge — updates need a manual Forge compatibility test
Python version must match Colab exactly — update manually following the process in README.md
Ubuntu runner must match Colab exactly — update manually following the process in README.md
